title: Jehoahaz
sourceLines: -1. Son of Jehu and king of Israel 2Ki 10:35; 13:1-9
-2. Son of Jehoram, king of Judah 2Ch 21:17
.King of Judah and successor of Josiah 2Ki 23:30,31; 1Ch 3:15; 2Ch 36:1; Jer 22:11
.Pharaoh-necho, king of Egypt, invades the kingdom of, defeats him, and takes him away captive to Egypt 2Ki 23:33-35; 2Ch 36:3,4
